title: The global --json flag is ignored by version and doctor
foundBy: session agent working in the simple-tools-demo repository, which runs a three member campaign at the pinned build of 2026-09-17, while scripting a version check
details:
`cs-campaign --help` lists `--json   print machine-readable JSON` as a global flag. `cs-campaign ls --json` does what the flag says. `cs-campaign version --json` and `cs-campaign doctor --json` both accept the flag, print their ordinary text, and exit 0.

A script that asks for JSON and gets text fails later and further away, in whatever parses the output. A flag a command cannot honour should be refused by that command.

To reproduce, run `cs-campaign version --json`. It prints the same single line of text as `cs-campaign version`.
